Elena — quick technical notes following Vanessa's outline: 

- Throughput baseline: a 16-GPU reserved pool (same instance type) should roughly double your steady-state tokens/sec for your current model mix; exact numbers depend on seq length distribution.
- Burst behavior: Redwood will preferentially route within the reserved pool; when steady demand exceeds pool+burst allowance we will route to compatible on-demand variants. Overage path has higher latency and different quantization profiles — we will document expected p95 latency impact.
- KV warm-up: Plan for a 24–48 hour pre-warm window for heavy KV-cache workloads during the switchover to avoid cold-start penalties.

Attachments: committed_capacity_8to16.xlsx (simple month-by-month commit profile), perf_notes_8to16.txt (short ops checklist).

Happy to run a short call with your infra leads to walk the changes.

- Karthik
Karthik Iyer
